import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static int my_find(String s1, String s2, int start) {
        if (s2.isEmpty()) return start;
        for (int i = start; i < s1.length(); i++) {
            if (i + s2.length() > s1.length()) break;
            if (s1.substring(i, i + s2.length()).equals(s2)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s1 = scanner.next();
        String s2, ans = "";
        
        int pos = my_find(s1, "at", 1);
        s2 = s1.substring(0, pos) + "@" + s1.substring(pos + 2);
        
        int i = my_find(s2, "dot", 1);
        int last = 0;
        while (i != -1 && i + 3 <= s2.length()) {
            ans += s2.substring(last, i);
            ans += ".";
            last = i + 3;
            i = my_find(s2, "dot", last);
        }
        ans += s2.substring(last);
        
        System.out.print(ans);
    }
}
